mapper.sql: id, policy_code, policy_name, max_tokens, cost_limit, currency, quota_window, status, remark
mapper.insert: insert into kb_quota_policies(policy_code, policy_name, max_tokens, cost_limit, currency, quota_window, status, remark) values(#{policyCode}, #{policyName}, #{maxTokens}, #{costLimit}, #{currency}, #{quotaWindow}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update kb_quota_policies set policy_name = #{policyName}, max_tokens = #{maxTokens}, cost_limit = #{costLimit}, currency = #{currency}, quota_window = #{quotaWindow}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
